content.text:
I worked out the d³ octahedral Tanabe–Sugano levels for C/B = 3390/828 = 4.0942 at all nine grid points. I did not save diagram.png, because I can't run code here and so could not make the plot.

The energies come from diagonalising the d³ strong-field matrices by hand: 2×2 for ⁴T₁g, 4×4 for ²Eg, and 5×5 for ²T₁g and ²T₂g. I recalled these matrices rather than derived them, so I checked them before using them. At Dq/B = 0 each matrix gives the correct free-ion energies (trace, sum of squared eigenvalues, the C = 0 determinant for ²Eg, and the eigenvalue −6B appearing three times for ²T₁g). For ²T₂g I could only confirm two of the five free-ion eigenvalues directly, so its matrix rests on fewer checks.

I found the roots by evaluating determinants and counting negative pivots, then interpolating. They should be good to about ±0.01 B (the ²T₂g values to about ±0.02 B). At each point I checked by pivot counting that no other levels (²A₁g, ⁴T₁g(P), or the second roots of ²Eg, ²T₁g and ²T₂g) fall below the sixth one.

Two places are close or arbitrary:
- **Dq/B = 0:** the four ²G components (²Eg, ²T₁g, ²T₂g, ²A₁g) are all at 16.283. Which two count as levels 5 and 6 is a choice; I took ²Eg and ²T₁g because they are the two lowest just above zero.
- **Dq/B = 0.5:** the sixth level is ²A₁g at 21.283, only just below ⁴T₁g(P) at 21.325.

Main results (E/B above the ⁴A₂g ground level, which stays lowest throughout):

| Dq/B | Six lowest levels (E/B) |
|---|---|
| 0 | ⁴A₂g 0, ⁴T₂g 0, ⁴T₁g(F) 0, ⁴T₁g(P) 15, ²Eg 16.28, ²T₁g 16.28 |
| 0.5 | ⁴A₂g 0, ⁴T₂g 5.00, ⁴T₁g(F) 8.68, ²Eg 18.43, ²T₁g 19.14, ²A₁g 21.28 |
| 1.0 | ⁴A₂g 0, ⁴T₂g 10.00, ⁴T₁g(F) 16.48, ²Eg 18.95, ²T₁g 19.88, ²T₂g 25.78 |
| 1.5 | ⁴A₂g 0, ⁴T₂g 15.00, ²Eg 19.25, ²T₁g 20.21, ⁴T₁g(F) 23.29, ²T₂g 27.59 |
| 2.0 | ⁴A₂g 0, ²Eg 19.47, ⁴T₂g 20.00, ²T₁g 20.41, ²T₂g 28.83, ⁴T₁g(F) 29.36 |
| 2.5 | ⁴A₂g 0, ²Eg 19.65, ²T₁g 20.55, ⁴T₂g 25.00, ²T₂g 29.77, ⁴T₁g(F) 35.00 |
| 3.0 | ⁴A₂g 0, ²Eg 19.78, ²T₁g 20.65, ⁴T₂g 30.00, ²T₂g 30.49, ⁴T₁g(F) 40.41 |
| 3.5 | ⁴A₂g 0, ²Eg 19.90, ²T₁g 20.72, ²T₂g 31.06, ⁴T₂g 35.00, ⁴T₁g(F) 45.68 |
| 4.0 | ⁴A₂g 0, ²Eg 20.00, ²T₁g 20.78, ²T₂g 31.52, ⁴T₂g 40.00, ⁴T₁g(F) 50.88 |

The ⁴T₂g energy is exactly 10Dq/B at every point.
